title: Satellite Images: Suspected Scam Compounds Surge in Myanmar
excerpt: Recent satellite imagery reveals dozens of suspected scam compounds are being built in remote Myanmar regions, despite government crackdown claims. The rapid construction pace indicates sophisticated criminal logistics and enforcement failures, posing a growing global cybersecurity threat.
description: Satellite images show dozens of new scam compounds built in Myanmar despite crackdown promises, revealing sophisticated criminal logistics and enforcement gaps.
